Live from NPR News in Washington, D.C., I'm Dale Willman.
Former President Barack Obama was at a rally in Cleveland Saturday.
He defended Ohio's Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton
after a controversial attack ad from Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign.
The ad has gained national headlines.
IdeaStream public media's Connor Morris has more.
The ad, paid for by Ramaswamy's campaign, features Acton's mother calling her a liar.
Acton's campaign says her mother stood by her stepfather's side
even after he was charged with sexually abusing Acton as a child.
Obama said those experiences with hardship mean Acton will look out for Ohio residents.
Amy has spoken movingly about her painful childhood
and all she's experienced in abuse, neglect and homelessness.
And she's never forgotten the people who looked out for her.
The rally was part of a push by Obama in the Midwest
to boost Democrat candidates in the midterm election.
For NPR News, I'm Connor Morris in Cleveland.
President Trump cast his ballot for the midterm elections on Saturday.
He was joined by First Lady Melania Trump at a polling location in West Palm Beach, Florida.
He later traveled to Georgia to speak at a political rally there
for Republican Byron Donalds, who's running for governor.
While there, he also announced that automaker Audi
will be building a new facility near Macon
that will create 4,500 jobs when it opens in the early 2030s.
The U.S. is easing tariffs on Canadian products ahead of the midterm elections
and Pierre's Chantalice Duster has more.
The Trump administration on Friday said it will lift 50 percent tariffs
on some Canadian products, such as packing supplies,
refrigerator equipment, plywood sheets, and some paper products will also have tariffs removed.
But other Canadian goods, such as waste products and carpets, will have tariffs added.
By removing the tariffs, the White House says President Trump is
offsetting the burden to U.S. commerce while better serving the public interest.
The U.S. and Canada have not reached an agreement on trade.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney told reporters on Friday
that the chance of a deal being reached before the midterm elections is, quote,
"up to the United States."
The new tariff changes will go into effect Friday, October 30th,
less than a week before the midterm elections.
Chantalice Duster, NPR News.
Hundreds of people have been rescued from flooded homes along the San Juan River
near Farmington, New Mexico.
The efforts followed severe storms and flash flooding
across the southwestern U.S. that began Wednesday.
San Juan County Fire Chief David Vega says crews continue to go door-to-door
to make sure no one else is trapped.
As the water's starting to recede in some areas,
that's going to provide us an opportunity for us to get crews in,
do a very slow, methodical search of all the houses to make sure that we haven't missed anything.
Weather officials say still more water surges may be happening this weekend.
You're listening to NPR News.
Research rockets lifted off over Fairbanks, Alaska this week
to look at the after-lives of dying stars.
As Shelby Herbert of Alaska Public Media reports,
the NASA experiment is also zooming in on something much smaller,
the dust being given off by those stars.
Two rockets pierced thick snow clouds above Alaska.
The first looked at a nebula left behind by a dying star, Messier 27.
The second carried a tiny lab that recreated the extremely hot,
gravity-free conditions inside the nebula
that make the tiny grains of dust that make up the universe.
NASA scientist Joe Nooth heads up that project.
If the growth process is efficient,
what you make are the equivalent of big rocks.
Nooth says the study could further scientific understanding
of the dust produced by volcanic eruptions and coal-fired power plants,
of which Alaska has both.
For NPR News, I'm Shelby Herbert in Fairbanks.
Milwaukee won Game 2 of the World Series Saturday,
beating Tampa Bay 5-4 for a two-game lead and in college football.
Number one Miami easily handled Pittsburgh 52-23,
but number two BYU lost to unranked UCF and double overtime, 39-31.
It's the latest upset of a number two team this year.
Took a touchdown run by quarterback Josh Hoover in overtime for number six Indiana
to squeak out a 13-6 win over Michigan.
Number seven Ole Miss lost to struggling Texas team 34-27,
while number eight Texas Tech lost to unranked Cincinnati.
And Ashland beat Kentucky Wesleyan by a score of 56 to nothing.
I'm Dale Willman, NPR News.
